name: _explore.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  awards-carousel/_explore.scss — the explore-more/archive variant — ~60% active card, inactive cards peeking, card styling, active-only label.
//  Imported by awards-carousel.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  VARIANT: explore more (archive cards)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Layout: carousel width is controlled by home.scss (61% on desktop, 100% mobile).
// Inside that, the active card fills ~60% of the carousel width.
// Adjacent cards peek from both sides.
// Labels hidden on inactive, fade in on active.

// Explore variant — alternate sizing/density.
.aw-c--explore {
  position: relative;

  // ── Controls: vertically centered on the image area ──────────────────────

  // ── Track ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .aw-c-track {
    gap: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;

    @include layout-768() {
      gap: to-rem($space-xl);
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      gap: to-rem($space-2xl);
    }
  }

  // ── Slide widths: ~60% of the carousel container ──────────────────────────
  .aw-c-slide {
    width: 85%;
    flex-basis: 85%;
    max-width: 85%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    // Padding so the card shadow isn't clipped by the track overflow
    padding: to-rem($space-sm);

    @include layout-540() {
      width: 70%;
      flex-basis: 70%;
      max-width: 70%;
    }
    @include layout-768() {
      width: 62%;
      flex-basis: 62%;
      max-width: 62%;
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      width: 60%;
      flex-basis: 60%;
      max-width: 60%;
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      width: 60%;
      flex-basis: 60%;
      max-width: 60%;
    }
    @include layout-2560() {
      width: 58%;
      flex-basis: 58%;
      max-width: 58%;
    }
  }

  // ── Card styling ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .aw-c-card {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);

    &-cover {
      width: 100%;
      overflow: visible; // allow reflection to show below
      background: var(--grey-2);
      flex-shrink: 0;

      &-img {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        display: block;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease;

        .aw-c-card:hover &,
        .aw-c-card:focus & {
          opacity: 0.9;
        }
      }

      // Reflected image below the main cover
      &-reflection {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        max-height: to-rem($space-3xl);
        display: block;
        transform: scaleY(-1);
        object-fit: cover;
        object-position: bottom;
        pointer-events: none;
        -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 1), transparent);
        mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 1), transparent);
      }

      &--skel {
        padding-top: 56.25%;
        background: linear-gradient(
          90deg,
          var(--skel-bg-1) 25%,
          var(--skel-bg-2) 50%,
          var(--skel-bg-3) 75%
        );
        background-size: 200% 100%;
        animation: skeleton-shimmer 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
    }

    // ── Label: hidden on non-active slides, fades in on active ──────────────
    &-label {
      padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-sm);
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition:
        opacity 0.4s ease,
        visibility 0.4s;
      pointer-events: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;

      &-title {
        @extend .ttl-md;

        font-weight: 200;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        padding-top: to-rem($space-md);
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
      }

      &-desc {
        @extend .txt-sm;

        font-weight: 100;
        opacity: 0.7;
      }
    }

    // "Click to open" — centered, corner-border animation.
    // Sits outside label div, always at the bottom of the card.
    &-action {
      @extend %RESETBTN;
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      position: relative;
      display: block;
      text-align: center;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
      color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.2s ease;
      margin: 0 auto to-rem($space-md);
      margin-top: auto; // pushes to bottom of card
      width: fit-content;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;

      &::before,
      &::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: to-rem($space-md);
        height: to-rem($space-md);
        transition:
          width 0.25s ease,
          height 0.25s ease;
      }

      &::before {
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--grey);
        border-left: 1px solid var(--grey);
      }

      &::after {
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grey);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--grey);
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus {
        color: var(--black);
      }

      &:hover::before,
      &:focus::before,
      &:hover::after,
      &:focus::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
      }
    }
  }

  // Active slide: label + action fade in
  .aw-c-slide--active .aw-c-card-label {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  // Action button appears after the description animation finishes
  .aw-c-slide--active .aw-c-card-action {
    animation: action-appear 0.4s ease-out forwards;
    animation-delay: var(--action-delay, 0ms);
  }
}
